inference_input_policy: The model receives only parent_event and direct_child_events. Source identity, figure/page, diagram, gate glyph, caption, label evidence, and expected gate are withheld.
scope_note: Small descriptive external classification probe only. It tests whether the model can infer the diagram gate from event wording; it does not test evidence-backed gate authorization from raw fault text. Unknown/insufficient-evidence behavior must be evaluated separately and is not represented as a diagram gate label.

excluded_examples.reason: Abstract Q/A/B examples have no event semantics; scoring their hidden diagram labels as text-inferable would conflate diagram truth with evidence sufficiency.
The child text 'B OR C' exposes the nested gate label and is an algebraic illustration repeated in another handbook.
The event text itself contains 'or', leaking the expected label.
